metadata.title: 3 reasons why Palo Alto Networks’ stock fell despite upbeat earnings - MarketWatch

content.text:
Tech Stocks
3 reasons why Palo Alto Networks’ stock fell despite upbeat earnings
Analysts attribute the stock drop to profit-taking, the timing of AI contributions and changes to reporting conventions
Palo Alto Networks posted better-than-expected results for the latest quarter on Tuesday. So did shares of the cybersecurity company fall on Wednesday?
Analysts have a few theories, one of which simply relates to recent stock momentum ahead of earnings.
